#include <string>

namespace bank {

template <typename T>
class Box {
public:
    T value;
    Box(T v) : value(v) {}
    T get() const { return value; }
};

class Repo : public Base {
public:
    Repo(int n) : limit_(n) {}
    std::string find(const std::string &id, int n = 3);
    static int helper(int p) { return p; }

private:
    int limit_;
};

std::string Repo::find(const std::string &id, int n) {
    auto q = "SELECT " + id;
    for (auto &x : items) {
        std::cout << x;
    }
    auto f = [&q](int a) { return a + limit_; };
    Repo *r = new Repo(3);
    r->helper(1);
    return q;
}

}  // namespace bank

using namespace std;
